# Psalm 17 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** A-prayer of-David. Hear, YHWH, [what is] righteous; attend to-my-cry; give-ear to-my-prayer from lips without deceit.

**2** From-Your-presence my-judgment comes-forth; Your-eyes see uprightness.

**3** You-have-tested my-heart; You-have-visited [me] in-the-night; You-have-refined-me — You-find nothing; I-have-purposed [that] my-mouth shall-not transgress.

**4** As-for the-deeds of-man, by-the-word of-Your-lips I have-kept [myself] from-the-paths of-the-violent.

**5** My-steps have-held to-Your-tracks; my-feet have-not slipped.

**6** I call-upon You, for You-answer-me, O-God; incline Your-ear to-me; hear my-speech.

**7** Wondrously-show Your-steadfast-love, O-Savior of-those-who-take-refuge, from-those-rising-up, by-Your-right-hand.

**8** Guard-me as-the-apple of-the-eye; in-the-shadow of-Your-wings hide-me,

**9** from-the-face of-the-wicked who despoil-me, my-deadly enemies who-surround-me.

**10** Their-fat they-have-closed; their-mouth speaks with-arrogance.

**11** Our-steps — now they-have-surrounded-us; their-eyes they-set to-cast [us] to-the-ground.

**12** His-likeness [is] like-a-lion longing to-tear, and-like-a-young-lion lurking in-hiding-places.

**13** Arise, YHWH! Confront his-face; bring-him-down! Deliver my-soul from-the-wicked [by] Your-sword,

**14** from-men, by-Your-hand, YHWH — from-men of-the-world, whose-portion [is] in-this-life, and-whose-belly You-fill with-Your-treasure. They-are-satisfied [with] sons, and-they-leave their-surplus to-their-children.

**15** As-for-me, in-righteousness I-shall-behold Your-face; I-shall-be-satisfied when-I-awake [with] Your-likeness.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **17:8**: 'Apple of the eye' (ishon bat ayin) — literally 'little man, daughter of the eye,' the pupil reflecting the image of the one looking in.

— EMET
